disclosure: The 40-exposure four-band footprint gate passed, the six target image coordinates and radii were known, and the program-11710 all-exposure center-coverage gate had failed. No program-9289 science value, source detection, PSF star, BCG profile, lens centroid, covariance, lens residual, mass residual, or gravity residual had been inspected.
purpose: Measure a theory-neutral BCG tracer-light profile and empirical image-position covariance on the same A1689 support as the raw GMOS dynamics, without fitting a lens mass model or a gravitational response.

registration_and_psf.common_grid: north-up ICRS tangent plane at the frozen common center with 0.05 arcsec pixels; resample science once with Lanczos3 and inverse variance with the squared interpolation kernel
registration_and_psf.per_exposure_registration: Fit a six-parameter affine correction from Gaia DR3 stars plus internally matched compact sources detected at >=10 sigma; no arc or BCG residual may enter registration.
registration_and_psf.empirical_psf_star_rule: Begin with Gaia candidates satisfying the frozen query. Retain unsaturated, isolated candidates whose measured FWHM is 0.05-0.18 arcsec and whose ellipticity is <0.25 in at least three filters. Selection uses only point-source morphology, never BCG, arc, lens, or gravity residuals.
registration_and_psf.psf_model: oversampled ePSF per exposure and filter, normalized to unit flux; propagate leave-one-star variation
registration_and_psf.failure_rule: If fewer than three empirical PSF stars or the registration RMS gate fails, stop both photometry and astrometry; do not substitute a post-result analytic PSF.

source_mask.detection_image: inverse-variance sum of the six DRC science images after scalar photometric calibration
source_mask.segmentation: 3-sigma connected detection with at least 5 pixels; retain the BCG segment but mask all other segments after dilation by twice their Kron radius
source_mask.known_lens_images: Mask all cataloged lens images during BCG-profile extraction using 0.8-arcsec circular masks; do not mask the six targets during their own astrometric fits.
source_mask.mask_sensitivity: Repeat with 1.5 and 2.5 Kron-radius dilation; all variants enter systematic covariance.

bcg_tracer_light.center: joint four-filter PSF-convolved elliptical Moffat centroid on 0.2-2.0 arcsec support, bounded within 0.15 arcsec of the frozen common center
bcg_tracer_light.radial_profile: circularized nonparametric surface brightness in fixed annuli; no Sersic decomposition is required or used as the primary profile
bcg_tracer_light.sky_model: masked affine plane per exposure and filter
bcg_tracer_light.covariance: 200-replicate exposure bootstrap stratified by filter and visit, with shared registration, ePSF, center, sky-plane, and mask-variant perturbations; retain full cross-filter and cross-radius covariance
bcg_tracer_light.interpretation: This measures tracer light relative to an outer sky and retains ICL/sky ambiguity as a nuisance. It does not yet assign stellar mass or separate BCG from ICL.

lens_astrometry.targets: the six independently redshift-anchored images inside the realized 15-kpc dynamics support
lens_astrometry.bcg_subtraction: subtract only the frozen nonparametric four-band BCG light model while jointly perturbing its covariance
lens_astrometry.per_filter_model: PSF-convolved elliptical Moffat plus affine local background, with one common sky centroid per filter and exposure-specific flux; fit all unmasked FLC pixels jointly
lens_astrometry.cross_filter_combination: Generalized least-squares mean of accepted filter centroids; include exposure bootstrap, affine-registration covariance, PSF leave-one-star covariance, BCG subtraction covariance, and between-filter centroid scatter
lens_astrometry.failure_rule: Retain every failed image/filter fit. Do not recenter an aperture, discard a filter, or borrow a positional error from a fitted lens residual.

stage_outcomes.outcome: Empirical ePSFs and a residual-blind common astrometric frame.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: >=3 PSF stars, >=20 registration sources, and <=0.05 arcsec leave-one-source RMS.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Stop this HST route on PSF or registration failure; do not use the lens fit to calibrate coordinates.

stage_outcomes.outcome: Four-band 16-bin BCG tracer-light profile with full covariance to >=4.7 arcsec.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: Every stated center, S/N, support, bootstrap, sky/mask sensitivity, and PSD gate passes.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Keep only the raw photometry shortfall and do not map light to stellar mass.

stage_outcomes.outcome: A joint coordinate covariance for >=3 independent lens images/radii on the dynamics support.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: Every retained image meets the detection, exposure/filter, centroid-stability, uncertainty, and PSD gates.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Keep A1689 as numerical dynamics plus geometry only; do not infer a Weyl response.
